name: China
description: Follow China, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump administration to declassify documents relating to China and U.S. elections
changes.summary: President Donald Trump addressed the nation from the White House, announcing that the administration will declassify documents related to the 2020 election and alleged influence by China.

changes.title: Trump speaks on elections, alleges Chinese access to voter data | Special Report
changes.summary: President Trump on Thursday delivered a primetime address about election security where he railed against China. Tony Dokoupil anchored CBS News' special report.

changes.title: How paper ballots make digital manipulation of results unlikely
changes.summary: NBC News’ Jane Timm analyzes President Trump’s claims about digital manipulation of ballot results in the U.S., as Trump said that the White House will declassify documents related to the 2020 election and alleged influence by China during his speech to the nation.

changes.title: US politicians push agencies to restrict research collaboration with China
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 16 July 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02226-9 Republicans and Democrats worry about research theft and exploitation — but don’t agree on how to solve the problem.

changes.title: China's Xi calls for step up of global effort in AI, as US curbs squeeze China's tech access
changes.summary: American-led restrictions have blocked China from accessing some of the world's most advanced technologies, spurring China's efforts to build its own know-how and intensifying the tech race between the world's two biggest economies. (Image credit: Ng Han Guan).

changes.title: Philippines Condemns AI Video Posted by Chinese State Media Depicting It as a Monkey
changes.summary: It lodged a diplomatic complaint with Beijing over an A.I.-generated video centered on territorial disputes in the South China Sea.

changes.title: How Trump's election allegations against China could impact relations with U.S.
changes.summary: President Trump accused China of having a role in influencing the 2020 election during his speech about election interference. NBC News' Garrett Haake has more on how this could impact China's relationship with the U.S.

changes.title: How paper ballots make digital manipulation of results unlikely
changes.summary: NBC News’ Jane Timm analyzes President Trump’s claims about digital manipulation of ballot results in the U.S., as Trump said that the White House will declassify documents related to the 2020 election and alleged influence by China during his speech to the nation.

changes.title: Special Report: Trump delivers speech on election infrastructure
changes.summary: NBC News correspondents break down President Trump's address to the nation on election integrity where the president described information he says is now declassified related to allegations about voter fraud, including accusations against China.

changes.title: China’s Economy Grows at Slowest Pace in Years
changes.summary: Economic growth of 4.3 percent in the second quarter, versus the same period last year, reflected a broad slump outside of the country’s export-oriented manufacturing might.
